coins.name: CSmid
coins.desc: CS MID is a tactical shooter right in your browser: 5v5 bomb defusal, deathmatch and 1v1 duels on two original maps. Play with bots for free or queue for online matches. A 2% fee on every trade, 60% of it goes to the prize funds of team tournaments.

coins.name: GTAmid
coins.desc: GTA MID is an open-world city game in your browser: a huge map with Mid City, highways, rivers and sea, cars, helicopters and planes, and 27 story missions. Early access: the game is in development and nothing can be earned in it yet. A 2% fee on every trade, half of it goes to the game's fund.

coins.name: MID
coins.desc: MID is a browser pixel MMORPG on Solana: explore the world, fight monsters, clear dungeons and battle other players in the arena. The MID in your wallet sets your hero's tier, and a 5% fee on every trade goes to the game and its players' pool.
